_comment: The round island's layout (plan phase 3 step 1, for Raven's sign-off). Made by Tools/terrain/round_island.mjs: change that, not this. Metres; x east, y south; bearings in degrees clockwise from north. Land areas = Aaron's surface sizes (world-map.md 2.2) x 2. Borders wander and blend over blendMetres either side; a land's polygon is its exact shape before the blend.

meadow.note: the Commons: a green meadow round the walls where the main roads arrive; guarded, no wild creatures, nothing owned (Raven's answers)

lake.note: in the meadow on the Ocean side; its stream runs out through the Ocean shore into the reef bay

bands.name: inland (hard)
bands.note: fractions of the way from the meadow's edge (0) to the coast (1)

bands.name: midlands
bands.note: fractions of the way from the meadow's edge (0) to the coast (1)

bands.name: coast (easy)
bands.note: fractions of the way from the meadow's edge (0) to the coast (1)

features.note: the volcano cape: the Volcanic juts out to sea
the reef bay on the Ocean shore, islets across its mouth
a cliff cape below the Storm peaks, sea stacks off it
an icy headland on the Tundra

sky.note: thickest over Storm peaks, the Desert and the Forest; a few more over other lands

crystal.note: under the Forest and the Tundra; deeper halls hold harder creatures and better ore

fungal.note: under the Graveyard and the Wasteland, across the island from the sky (Wind and Spore are opposites)

severance.note: a rift-cut gorge down into the Crystal caves, on the Forest–Tundra border

flue.note: the shaft up from the Fungal caverns, a sky island anchored over it

wind.note: a low starter sky island over the north coast: ropes, ledges and updrafts down

spore.note: a shallow cavern under the south-west coast; no markings out

arcane.note: a shallow crystal hall under the north-east coast; no markings out
